name: Phantom Crowd
summary: Fills an area with an illusory crowd that obscures your allies.

stats.effect: You create illusory people filling a 20-foot Cube within range. The area is Lightly Obscured, and creatures in it have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. A creature that uses its action to examine the crowd and succeeds on an Intelligence (Investigation) check discerns the illusion.
